top_signals.title: Sutcliffe: US Appears Set to Reengage With Iran
top_signals.summary: Oil pushed lower on cautious optimism over efforts to end the US-Iran war. Axios reports VP Vance met with Qatar’s prime minister to discuss negotiations with Iran despite President Trump’s latest threat to resume attacks next year if talks fail. Megan Sutcliffe, Principal Analyst Middle East, Africa spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: B&Q owner Kingfisher targets higher profit as Screwfix soars
top_signals.summary: B&Q owner Kingfisher has lifted its profit target for the second time in just two months after seeing its shift towards trade customers drive demand at Screwfix.
